releases.notes:
Fixes missing stream sections when multistream upload demand exceeds your connection's upstream capacity. Supports **Minecraft 26.1.2, 26.2 and 26.3** with Fabric.

### Changes
- **Measured upload budget:** enter upload Mbps on Streaming. Every destination copy shares 80% of that capacity, including audio and VBR ceilings. The video rate is capped at session start while your requested bitrate preferences are retained.
- **Correct multistream accounting:** one shared encoder still needs a separate upload for each destination. Four outputs at 8,000 kbps video plus 160 kbps audio request 32.64 Mbps. On a 22.47 Mbps upload connection, budgeting caps video at 4,334 kbps each, totaling 17.976 Mbps with headroom.
- **Clear loss reporting:** Stream Health displays planned total upload and marks output Poor when queue overflow discards stream sections.
- **Continuity regression:** four throttled local receivers reproduce missing sections at excessive rates; with budgeting, every captured video frame and continuous audio reaches every receiver.

The user confirmed the previously reported skipping was resolved after this fix on Minecraft 26.2. The optional upload limit defaults to unknown (0); set your own measured upload speed. It does not measure bandwidth automatically or change bitrate during a running session.

### Install
Download the jar matching your Minecraft version. Replace the old Stream-able jar in `mods/`, keep only one, and restart Minecraft. Java 25, Fabric Loader, and the matching Fabric API are required. MCEF Modern is bundled. Settings and stream keys are preserved.

### Verification
All three release builds passed 504 tests, with eight optional tests skipped per target. GitHub CI verifies Linux builds, Windows 26.2 tests/build, and real Linux client boots on all three versions. User confirmation and local tests do not establish hours-long stability on every service.

Maintenance and verification assisted by Codex. No generated art/audio was added. See LICENSE and NOTICE for attribution.

releases.notes:
Reliability update for **Minecraft 26.1.2, 26.2 and 26.3** with Fabric.

### Fixes
- **Multistream stalls:** independent, bounded FFmpeg output queues keep a slow ingest from blocking the shared encoder and healthy destinations. Congested outputs may discard packets and resume at a keyframe.
- **Kick connections:** restore the required `/app` path and normalize standard Kick/IVS endpoints to RTMPS on port 443 while preserving saved keys and custom paths.
- **Stream Health:** show output condition and destination queue overflow episodes; encoder speed alone no longer labels the internet connection as poor.
- **Config preservation:** repair recoverable null fields without resetting unrelated settings; save through private, unique temporary files.
- **FFmpeg deadlines:** stuck probes and recording audio muxes terminate within bounded deadlines, with source recordings retained on mux failure.

### Install
Download the jar matching your Minecraft version and replace the previous Stream-able jar in `mods/`. Keep only one Stream-able jar. Fabric Loader and the matching Fabric API are required; Java 25 is required. MCEF Modern is bundled. Restart Minecraft after replacing the jar. Saved settings and destinations are retained.

### Verification
All three release targets passed 494 tests, with eight optional tests skipped per target. A real FFmpeg loopback congestion test verifies that a stalled receiver does not block a healthy output. GitHub CI checks Linux builds, Windows 26.2 tests/build, and real Linux client boots on all three Minecraft versions.

Independent output queues cannot add upload capacity: every destination still consumes bandwidth. Public ingest and ISP performance after this update need live verification.

Maintenance and verification assisted by Codex. No OBS code or generated art/audio was added. See the repository LICENSE and NOTICE for attribution.

releases.notes:
Stream-able now supports **Minecraft 26.1.2, 26.2 and 26.3**, one jar each. Pick the jar that matches your game and use the Fabric API build for that version.

| Jar | Minecraft | Fabric API |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stream-able-1.4.0-mc26.1.2-fabric.jar` | 26.1.2 | 0.155.3+26.1.2 |
| `stream-able-1.4.0-mc26.2-fabric.jar` | 26.2 | 0.161.0+26.2 |
| `stream-able-1.4.0-mc26.3-fabric.jar` | 26.3 | 0.161.0+26.3 |

Java 25, Fabric Loader >= 0.19.5. SHA-256 sums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

### Added
- 26.1.2 and 26.3 support. 26.3 moved from GLFW to SDL and to a new GPU API; keys, mouse buttons and shaders are handled per version (details in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).
- "Open folder" buttons no longer depend on a Minecraft helper that 26.3 removed.

### Fixed
- **Game crash on Vulkan.** Minecraft 26.2+ can render with Vulkan (Video Settings > Graphics API), and falls back to it if OpenGL cannot start. Stream-able captures through OpenGL and used to abort the whole game there. It now stays out of the way and Stream Health tells you to set the Graphics API to "Prefer OpenGL" and restart.

### Verified / not verified
Each jar was run in a dev client: boots with every mixin applied, the Studio opens and responds to keyboard and mouse. Real recordings (26.1.2, 26.2) and replay-buffer segments (26.3, OpenGL) contain the game's frames, with a live Chromium browser source composited in on all three. **Not exercised:** browser-source audio and interaction, Simple Voice Chat / Plasmo Voice, F12 clip saving on 26.3, Windows, and a real GPU OpenGL driver on 26.3 (tests used software OpenGL). Please report anything that misbehaves on your version.

releases.notes:
## Stream-able 1.3.1

Recording, capture, browser, and mic health on **Minecraft 26.2** (cycles 12–15 after 1.3.0).

### Highlights
- **Disk space guardian**: recording refuses to start / stops when the recordings volume hits the block threshold or under 100 MB free; Studio → Recording shows free space
- **Capture health in Studio**: live GPU readback time, capture FPS, PBO skips / buffer-exhaust per Recording / Streaming / Replay; broken outputs named as Stream Health CRITICAL
- **Browser CSS injector hardening**: 64 KiB clamp, DOM-ready retry, SPA `MutationObserver` re-apply, clears `background-image`
- **Mic DSP overrun Stream Health**: overload / backlog findings name queue depth, overruns, drops and point at Studio → Audio (lighter model / lower strength); drops escalate to CRITICAL

### Install
Drop `stream-able-1.3.1-mc26.2-fabric.jar` into `mods/` next to Fabric API for Minecraft **26.2** (Java 25).
